notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms.us list gives this tower any facts. The list line has no tag, status or note. The page has no legend for its columns, so the elevation is taken as feet, matching the record's 66.5 m. No NHLR, FFLOS, Forest Lookouts or photo source in the cache matched. Two web searches and a search of the Georgia Historic Newspapers site (its results page is script-only) found nothing on a tower or place called Fulch. Needs a records check before a longer story.
